title: Offline ML habits, usual routes & roundabout cues
features: Personal road-class and cold-weather (<= 3 °C) ETA calibration with realistic ~X-Y min reliability ranges.
Clear separation between historical Traffic diversions (yellow bypass) and learned Usual routes (normal route plus dashed teal), with dedicated prompts.
Recurring stop suggestions, Usual parking prompts, dwell-time trip chains and cyan-star preferred Nearby POIs.
Amber Frequent slowdown ahead and Cold-weather slowdown ahead alerts for repeat hard-braking hotspots.
Adaptive speed-band Auto zoom and automatic Day/Night learned brightness, plus desktop offline history replay (tools/replay_history.py).
Route-coloured stop/destination markers (highlighting mapped destination POIs in route colour) and an expandable secondary manoeuvre pill for roundabouts.
